decision.reason: An independent Synopsys VCS reproducer and an exact-SHA four-job rerun preserve both leaf ledgers, retain configuration after the last row, block release until matcher result retirement and adapter drain, close the same-cycle shell-fault and sticky aggregate-quiescence counterexample, and validate the q32/640-byte M384 directed receipt. The selected slice has no M384 replay-done input, so the external controller must still withhold phase_release_valid until M384 phase_done after both replays.

aggregate_fail_closed.attack: A wrong-tag PWP low and early release are presented while a matcher result is pending; all external producer valids and consumer readies are simultaneously active.

elastic_independent_directed.wide_lane0: zero-extended low 0x080 plus signed high 0xf00 equals -128

aggregate_fault_semantics.same_cycle_scope: Combinational shell violations explicitly named by R3, including wrong-tag PWP low and illegal phase release, enter shell_violation and quiesce exports in the same cycle.
aggregate_fault_semantics.leaf_fault_scope: Matcher/adapter-local errors are registered at the leaf protocol_error boundary and are globally quiescent when that aggregate error becomes visible. They are not claimed as combinational same-cycle shell violations.
aggregate_fault_semantics.malformed_high_padding: The high beat may handshake into the leaf validator, but no wide record or contribution is committed; at the first registered adapter fault the aggregate shell is fully quiescent and remains sticky.

phase_release_boundary.internally_proved: No release before last result retirement, no pending pass1, no active row ingress and no buffered/partially emitted adapter record.
phase_release_boundary.not_internally_proved: M384 bitmap seal, tile0 replay done, tile1 replay done or M384 phase_done.
phase_release_boundary.external_obligation: The real integration controller must connect M384 phase_done, whose semantics follow both replays, to phase_release_valid and must never assert it from selected-slice phase_release_ready alone.
phase_release_boundary.independent_observation: After result retirement with an empty adapter and before the testbench's modeled M384 replay completions, phase_release_ready is already one. This is contract-consistent external readiness, not proof that M384 finished.
phase_release_boundary.claim_downgrade: R3 admits a leaf/shell directed handshake boundary. It does not admit a physically integrated M384-to-selected-slice phase lifecycle.

findings.title: M384 completion remains outside the selected-slice release predicate
findings.detail: The shell has no M384 instance or replay_done/phase_done input. It becomes release-ready after matcher retirement and adapter drain even before modeled replays. Correct use therefore depends on an external controller driving phase_release_valid only from M384 phase_done after both replays.

findings.title: Same-cycle aggregate quiescence has an explicit shell-violation scope
findings.detail: Wrong-tag low and illegal release are combinational shell violations and quiesce all exports immediately. Leaf padding/config/row protocol errors are registered locally and globally quiesce at their visible error edge; R3 does not implement a combinational preview of every leaf fault. Atomic padding still leaks zero contributions.

findings.title: Leaf and integration coverage remains directed
findings.detail: The exact rerun covers 386 codec blocks and 64 synthetic q32 rows. It does not replace the frozen 442,368-block/42,467,328-lane codec population or the full real q32 phase miter planned for M408.

findings.title: The refreshed M384 evidence is VCS-only and separately instantiated
findings.detail: The 6240/38912/640 addresses, bounds, D8/L8 credit behavior and eight directed replays pass. M384 is not wired into the R3 shell, and its q32 SHA has no refreshed DC, Formality or PrimeTime receipt yet.

findings.title: No performance or physical claim transfers
findings.detail: M405R3/M407 prove directed RTL function and fail-closed integration only. They do not make 1.156371x RTL-measured, bound external backpressure, prove physical SRAM/DMA overlap, or admit DC, energy, system speedup, paper PPA or a DATE headline.
